review_text: Runs about half a size small in the shoulders. I normally wear a medium and the large fit me much better.
True to size for me at 180 cm and 78 kg. The medium is a clean fit with room for a t-shirt underneath.
The merino wool is soft and does not itch at all, even directly on the skin. No pilling after six washes.
Warm enough for a Stockholm autumn but too thin for real winter without a jacket over it.
I washed it at 30 degrees on the wool cycle and it kept its shape perfectly. Do not tumble dry, mine shrank slightly the one time I did.
Colour is a touch darker than the product photos, closer to a deep charcoal than grey.
Shipping took nine days to Sweden and customs added a fee, so factor that into the price.
Sleeves are long on me, I am 165 cm, so I have to cuff them. Otherwise a beautiful sweater.
Order a full size up. My usual EU 42 was painfully tight across the toe box.
The leather softened after about a week of wear and there was no blistering during break in.
Sole grip is excellent on wet pavement, I walk 8 km a day and they still look new after three months.
Not waterproof. A heavy rain soaked through the seams and it took a full day to dry.
The insole is thin so I swapped it for an orthotic. With that change they are comfortable all day.
Returns were painless, the label was in the box and the refund came back in four days.
The glass carafe feels sturdy and the mesh filter has not clogged once in two months of daily use.
One litre gives me about four servings of concentrate, so a brew lasts two days in our household.
It fits on the fridge door shelf but only just, measure yours before buying.
Dishwasher safe apart from the lid, which I hand wash to protect the silicone seal.
Coarse ground coffee and an 18 hour steep in the fridge gave the smoothest result for me.
Mine arrived with a chipped rim but support shipped a replacement within 48 hours without arguing.
